title: Keyframe Animation (ver. 2025.0)
content: YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-VbR6WqoAvc ### **Objective** By setting animation keys on an object’s properties, you can interpolate between keyframes to express animation over time. Edit the avatar’s joints to apply dynamic animations, or control the wind properties to create effects where the wind values change over time. Use these methods to create various animation effects. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ Animation ▶ Animation Editor Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Animation Editor Bottom Window Center ▶![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438117745049) Open Animation Editor icon Side Panel Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ Animation Editor ### ### **Add Keyframe** 1. Click Animation ▶ Animation Editor in the top menu. 2. Click the Add Animation button at the top left of the Animation Editor to view a list of objects that can have animations. 3. Select the target item to create an empty layer with no keyframes. 4. Expand the created layer, set the value of a property that can be keyed, and click the **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358157014681)**Insert Key button. _* This action works the same as clicking Insert Key in the Property Editor._ 5. Move the Current Frame, change the property value, and click Insert Key again to create another keyframe. 6. When you play the animation between the multiple keyframes, you can see the value change over time. ### ### **Animation Layer** 1. Right-clicking the created layer will display a context menu. 2. Layers have a hierarchical structure, and only the properties of an object that can be keyed are displayed as layers. 3. Layers can be deleted, and sub-property layers can be re-created using the Add Layer menu of the parent layer. An animation list item is structured as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Active Button** | When the button is turned on, the keyframes in the layer become active and functional. Child layers are dependent on the active status of their parent layer. **Layer Name** | The top-level layer displays its name along with an icon. Property layers display only the name. The layer name is synchronized with the actual target’s name. **Parameter Value** | Shows the value of the corresponding property and allows you to edit it. This value is synchronized with the Property Editor and will update together. **Key Controller** | Enables the insertion of keyframes and provides navigation to the previous or next keyframe. **※Note** : Only recorded Cache Layer can be cut or merged. ### ### **Animation Track** **Object Layer** 1. The object layer displays the Start-End keyframe range as a bar. 2. Hover the mouse over the bar to display the handles and precisely adjust its length. 3. As the length of the bar changes, the keyframes in the child layers stretch or shrink while maintaining their relative spacing. **Property Layer** 1. Actual keyframes are set on property layers. 2. Property layers can also be grouped, and the parent key in the group represents the keys of its children. 3. When the parent key is selected, all child keys on the same frame are selected as well, and actions such as moving, copying, deleting, or changing interpolation type are applied collectively. ### ### **Set Keyframe** **Manual Keyframe Creation** 1. Change the property value of the target object in the Animation Layer or Property Editor, then click the Insert Keyframe button. 2. The current property value of the target object will be set as a key at the current frame. **Automatic Keyframe Creation** 1. Enable Auto Keying. 2. Manually set the first key using the manual creation method. 3. After the initial key is set, any changes to the same property will automatically create a key at the current frame. **※Note** : The first key must be manually set in order for subsequent keys to be created automatically on that property. **Create Keyframes or Layers in Batch** 1. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012119691801)**Add Keyframe for Selected Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all currently selected layers. 2. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012104000537)**Add Keyframe for All Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , keyframes are created for all layers. 3. When ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/52012119707673)**Create All Object Layers** is executed from the **Animation Toolbar** , layers are created for all scene objects existing in the current world. **Copy and Paste Keyframes** 1. One or more keyframes can be copied and pasted relative to the current frame. 2. Meaningful paste results can only be achieved when pasting onto layers with the same data type. 3. When multiple keys are pasted, they retain the same spacing relative to the current frame. **Keyframe Interpolation Types** 1. To set the interpolation type, select keys and right-click to open the context menu. Choose the desired interpolation type from the menu. 2. Keyframe interpolation types can be set as follows: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Constant** | Maintains the current key's value until just before the next key. **Linear** | Creates a straight-line interpolation between keys, producing a constant rate of change. **Cubic** | Creates a curved interpolation between keys, resulting in smoother motion. This is visible when three or more keys are present. To apply the same interpolation type to all child keys, select the parent key of the property and change its interpolation type. All child keys will be updated accordingly. ### ### **Timeline Improvement** **Playback Range Context Menu** Use the following features to easily set the playback range. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Set Start Frame** | Sets the current frame as the start frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is larger than the end frame. **Set End Frame** | Sets the current frame as the end frame of the playback range. This menu is disabled if the current frame is less than the start frame. **Clamp Range to Active Frames** | Automatically adjusts the playback range to fit the span between the first and last keyframes across all layers. **※Note** : When **Clamp Range to Selected Layers** is executed from the track context menu of the selected animation layers, the playback range is adjusted to match the start and end keyframes of the selected layers. **S****lider Context Menu** Right-click the slider at the bottom of the Timeline and use the following options to control the Timeline view area. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Fit to Active Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Start Keyframe and End Keyframe. **Fit to Playback Range** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fit the Playback Range's Start Frame and End Frame. **Fit to Full Frames** | Adjusts the Timeline View to fir the defined Minimum Frame and Maximum Frame. **Supported Objects** Keyframe animation can be applied to the following objects: **Object** | **Description** ---|--- **Fabric** | The following properties can be controlled: * Front/Back/Side Material * Physical Property **※Note:** If **Use Same Material as Front** is enabled for the back/side material, it will not appear in the Layer. **Pattern** | The following properties can be controlled: * Fabric Index * Solidify (ver 2025.2) * Shrinkage Weft (%) (ver 2025.2) * Shrinkage Warp (%) (ver 2025.2) * Pressure (ver 2025.2) **※Note:** It is possible to transition between fabrics assigned to a pattern. When switching fabrics, the property values are interpolated. **Avatar** | The following properties can be controlled: * Joint **Pin** | The following properties can be controlled: * Activate **Tack** **(2025.2)** | The following properties can be controlled: * Tack: Activate * Tack: Thread Length (mm) * Line Tack: Activate * Line Tack: Thread Length (mm) **Wind Controller** | The following properties can be controlled: * Active * Unlimited Bound * Transform * Strength * Decay * Frequency * Turbulence **Simulation Property** | The following properties can be controlled: * Gravity * Air Damping **Cache** | Recorded Cache is classified into the following two types. **1\. Garment Cache** Caches recorded during simulation are keyed and categorized into **Pattern** and **Trim** Layers. **2\. Softbody Cache** Avatar motion recorded after enabling Softbody. **※Note:** Cache layers can be cut and merged individually by type.
content_description: Explore the Animation Editor to master the art of keyframing and create dynamic animations by manipulating object properties and interpolating values over time.

title: Can I Pause my Subscription?
content: ## **Q. Can I temporarily pause my subscription?** **A.** Yes, you can temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it. Your payment details will be saved, so you can easily resume your subscription without needing to repurchase it from scratch. _* Only personal monthly licenses can be paused. (Enterprise License, Student License, Trial License are not applicable)_ * * * ## ## **Subscription Pause** 1\. Log in to your account and go to the 'License' page. 2\. Click on **'Stop Subscription'**. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438238983705) 3\. Select **'Pause Subscription'** and choose a pause period of up to 6 months. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438283892633) 4\. Your subscription status will change to **'Pause Scheduled'** , meaning the pause will take effect once your current license expires. * * * ## ## **Additional Notes:** * While the status is **'Pause Scheduled'** , you can select **'Undo Pause'** to keep your subscription active. * During the pause period, you can **'Resume'** your subscription at any time before the pause ends. A new billing cycle will begin when you resume your subscription. * Any coupon discounts you have will still be valid after the pause period. * * * ## ## **Status Details:** #### ✅ **Active** Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You have full access to Marvelous Designer. #### ⏳ **Pause Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a pause has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. #### 🚫 **Paused** Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. #### 📅 **Cancel Scheduled** Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled cancellation date.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to temporarily pause your subscription to Marvelous Designer, ensuring you retain your payment details and can easily resume access without repurchasing.

For such requests, please **[submit a ticket](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=44414746707993)**. #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on Marvelous Designer cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the **[troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129)** for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![mceclip0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438326290585) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438281413913) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438281537689)![mceclip5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438326879129) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![mceclip12.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438327089433)![mceclip14.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438327433497) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the 'Email Switching' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the **[Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129)** for instructions. #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address in CLO-SET, detailing the process, implications, and troubleshooting steps to ensure a smooth transition.

title: Adjust Avatar Pose
content: ### Objective Adjust poses of avatar with joint information. From ver2.3.0 onwards, it displays sub-groups of avatar joints which enables to see direct groups of joint to be edited. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Avatar ▶ Show X-ray Joints (Shift + X) / Show Avatar Joints (ver 12) ▶ 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move 3D Window ▶ Avatar Display (Mouse-over) ▶ Show X-ray Joints (Shift + X) / Show Avatar Joints (ver 12) ▶ 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation #### FK (Forward Kinematics) 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. 2. Click on avatar's joint and use Gizmo to relocate and to edit rotation value. Click the 'Symmetric' icon at the top right of the gizmo to apply the rotation value of the joint point in a metric fashion. (ver. 5.1.431) #### IK (Inverse Kinematics) (ver. 2025.0) 1. Follow the path indicated in the Location section. 2. Set Option as needed: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- Edit Full Body | When a single joint is modified, it affects all other joints which are organically linked to the single joint. Edit Body Part | When a single joint is modified, only directly connected joints are modified. Constrain Joint Rotation | Activate the option to prevent unwanted movement of the selected joint caused by other rotating joints. However, for natural modification of the Avatar, the constrained joint may rotate slightly. Constrain Joint Translation | Activate the option to prevent unwanted movement of the selected joint caused by other moving joints. However, for natural modification of the Avatar, the constrained joint may move slightly. 3. Adjust the position and rotation by clicking on the joints in the Gizmo. Joints marked with green dots can be adjusted. Click the symmetry icon on the top right of gizmo to enable symmetric editing.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for adjusting avatar poses using joint information, featuring enhanced functionalities for both Forward Kinematics (FK) and Inverse Kinematics (IK) in the latest versions.

title: [Mode] UV EDITOR
content: ### Objective To edit UV for mapping 2D textures on patterns. ### Location Window ▶ UV Editor (Ver. 2025.0) Viewport Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ UV Editor (ver. 2025.0) UV Editor mode button on the toolbar at the top of the window. (up to Ver. 10) ### Operation Access the UV Editor from the Location above. Back and Side UV can be exported as UV. (Ver. 2025.0) #### [Definition of UV screen, coordination, and tiles] ![UV_Editor.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437954503577) Horizontal axis: U Vertical axis: V A square of one U/ V: Tile UV snapshot saves each Tile as a single image. The coordinates of the tile are determined by the coordinates of U and V and are the same as the UV coordinates inside each tile on the image above. #### [Definition of Wire] ![UV_Editor_wire.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438003616537) Wire is the mesh line (Polygon) of UV. Wire image will be saved when saving UV. **Show UV Wire (Ver. 7.5)** **Location:** UV Editor Mode Popup menu (Right-click on background) Show Wire The existing textures are hidden and UV Wire (meshes) are displayed. **Rendering View Settings (ver. 9)** The toolbar contains rendering options. Diffuse, Metalness, Normal, Roughness Map. **View UV Maps (ver. 10)** 1. Upper left of the UV Editor window ▶ Click the View UV Map icon → Map icons that can be changed appear horizontally. 2. Click the desired map icon. → The UV of the 2D window changes to the type of map users click. ※Note: The UV map of the OBJ topstitch used in a garment is also provided. (ver. 11) View and Bake Displacement Map is now available (ver. 11) **Texture Repeat Type (ver. 10)/ Texture Mapping (ver. 11)** If the Texture Repeat Type of the fabric is set to Unified Map, changing the position of the UV in the UV Editor Window moves the textures in 2D and 3D patterns to the textures in the changed location. Fabric Properties | Description ---|--- Texture Repeat Type (ver. 10)/ Texture Mapping (ver. 11) | Unified Map (ver. 10) / Unified (ver. 11) | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. [Repeat UV Settings] * Repeat U: Size the texture based on U direction. * Repeat V: Size the texture based on V direction. The number 1 means that the texture is repeated once between 0-1 of the UV map. **Move UV with Value (ver. 11)** 1. UV Editor Toolbar ▶ Click the Move UV tool. → Move UV window appears. 2. Set the distance to be moved. Distance 1 indicates the length of the segment of the UV Tile in the UV Editor window. 3. Move the UV by clicking the Arrow icon or pressing the directional keys on the keyboard. → UV is moved according to the distance you set.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for using the UV Editor in version 2025.0 to efficiently edit UV mappings for 2D textures on patterns.

title: [MODE] UV EDITOR: Bake Textures
content: ### Objective Bake selected texture. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ UV Editor Mode ▶ Tool Bar ▶ Bake Textures Tool ### Operation 1. Set values according to the table below. **Bake Textures Detail Setting Table** Saving Path | Click folder button to set the file path and save path. Select PNG either JPEG file format. With PNG save option, the background will be transparent. With JPEG save option, the background will be black. ---|--- Size (pixels) | Set the size of the image to be saved. After setting the details, click the "Save" button at the bottom. → The image is baked and saved to the path you set. ※ Note: * When baking, the seamline normal map will be baked together. (ver.10) * The UV map of the OBJ topstitch used in a garment is also provided. (ver.11) * UV padding pixel value can be adjusted using Fill Texture Seams value. title: Topstitch Style Property Editor (ver. 2025.0)
content: Topstitch Style Property Editor Topstitch Property Editor Topstitch Context Menu * * * ## Topstitch Style Property Editor ### Objective Use these options to edit Topstitch styles and materials. **** ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ (Select) Topstitch Style ▶ Property editor ### Operation Object Browser ▶ Select a topstitch item in the Topstitch Tab. → The properties are displayed in the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Enter a name for the Topstitch. | Type | Select either OBJ to create a 3D mesh, or Texture to apply the effect as a material. Offset | Select the Offset distance from the dropdown menu in inches, or enter a value in millimeters in the input box. Stitch Count | Select between 1 and 5 stitches. For multiple stitches, you can apply unique material properties to each one. Enable Use Same Specification to apply identical settings, or Use Same Material to use the same material settings across all stitches. Specification | Shape | Select the type of topstitch from the drop-down icon. Click the plus + icon to[ register the topstitch as an OBJ file **(link here)**.](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358155220249) Click the CONNECT icon to open the CONNECT Store and download buttons. OBJ | Texture Bartack | ![bartack_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438335426713) | ![bartack.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438330503577) Buttonhole | ![buttonhole_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438335994649) | ![buttonhole.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438336244761) Single | ![topstitch_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438331382169) | ![default.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438331645081) Overlock | ![overlock_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438337029145) | ![overlock.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438337328281) Pickstitch | ![pickstitch_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438337596185) | ![pickstitch.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438332674969) Zigzag | ![zigzag_render.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438338110873) | ![zigzag.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438417186585) Set the Length (SPI), Space, and Thread Thickness of the Topstitch. ※Note: SPI stands for Stitch Per Inch, meaning the number of stitches within an inch. For example, 'SPI-4' means there are four individual stitches within an inch. For standard garments, SPI-11 is often used. Material Button / Thread | Type | Set the appropriate fabric type for the topstitch. ---|---|--- Base Color | Color | Select the color of the base color. Base Color Map | Base Color Map | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from the Library/Folder. Desaturate | Desaturate the entire Base Color Map to remove color and convert it into grayscale or black and white. Switch | Color Switch: Easily and quickly switch the color of the texture to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438338582553) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected results. Normal Map | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from the Library/Folder. Generate with the PBR texture generator icon. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal map from -100 to 100. Displacement Map | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder, generated with the PBR texture generator icon. Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Opacity | Adjust the opacity level from 0 to 100. Opacity Map | RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in the RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with the alpha value in the alpha channel. Reflection | Roughness | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting the Intensity of the Roughness Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying the Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shiny part becomes dull and vice versa. Reflection Intensity | The greater/lesser the Reflection Intensity value is, the more reflective/dull the material or fabric is, and vice versa. Metalness | Adjust the metallic level. A higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. Configuration | Face | Select the Face of Topstitch. Number of Lines | Set how many lines of Topstitches there are for a single style. Distance | It is possible to adjust the distance between the lines. The unit of length can be set in inches, millimeters (mm), or centimeters (cm). 3D | The Topstitch is more realistic in the 3D window. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438417580057) ## Topstitch Property Editor ### Objective Use these options to edit topstitch styles: * Extend: When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or stick out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the outline of the Pattern. * Corner: Set the Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Topstitch ### Operation Find the menu from the location above, and select a topstitch line in the 2D pattern window. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Property | Description ---|--- Name | Rename Topstitch. Topstitch Property | Select the Topstitch to edit its properties. Extend | Turn On/Off the settings in Start / End. Corner | Curved | When turned On, the selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. ![rightangledcorner.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438417837593) ※ Note: Corner settings only apply when connecting with Free Topstitch Sewing. Right Angled | When turned On, the selected Topstitch is now a right angle. Z Offset (mm) | Enter a value in millimeters to set the offset from the pattern surface. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438417580057) ## Topstitch Context Menu ### Objective Use these options to manage topstitch, including deleting and renaming. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Topstitch ### Operation Right-click a button in the location panel to rearrange the topstitch list. **Menu** | **Description** ---|--- Delete | Deletes the selected Topstitch style. ※Note: You can also delete them with the Delete Topstitch on the keyboard. A Topstitch Style can only be deleted if there is no Topstitch assigned to it. Delete All Unused Topstitches | Removes unused Topstitches from the Topstitch list. Rename | Rename the Topstitch style. Reset | Resets the properties of the Topstitch style to the Default Topstitch properties.

title: Puckering (ver 2024.0)
content: Create puckering Apply Puckering Edit Puckering Puckering Style Properties Assign Puckering Style Puckering Style Properties Show/Hide Puckering ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Create puckering You can create puckering on pattern outlines, inner line segments, and sewing lines. ### ## Apply Puckering ### Objective Apply puckering textures, including normal and base color maps for detailed surface definition and fold points at seams to create realistic-looking fabric gathers and wrinkles along seamlines. ### Operation **Segment Puckering** Select a line segment to create puckering. 1\. Select the Segment Puckering tool via the path below. Location Main Menu → Materials → Puckering → Segment Puckering 2D Window Toolbar → Segment Puckering 2\. Click the segment you want to create a puckering for. **Free puckering** You can create puckering on pattern outlines and internal lines regardless of segment points. 1\. Select the Free Puckering tool via the path below. Location Main Menu → Materials → Puckering → Free Puckering 2D Window Toolbar → Free Puckering 2\. Set the first and last points on the line where you want to create the puckering by clicking the mouse. **Seamline Puckering** You can create a puckering on a pattern seamline. 1\. Select the Seamline Puckering tool via the path below. Location Main Menu → Materials → Puckering → Seamline Puckering 2D Window Toolbar → Seamline Puckering 2\. Click on the Sewing Line to create the puckering. ### End Result → Puckering is created on that line. → You can see the puckering created on the 3D Garment. → For Seamline Puckering, the puckering will appear on one or both Sewing Lines depending on the 'Placement' set in the Puckering Properties. ※Note: In the 2D window, you can create puckering in one step by clicking and dragging an area to include all the desired line segments. Puckering cannot be created twice. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Edit Puckering You can select and modify the puckering applied (move the position, modify the length/width). ### Operation 1\. Select the Edit Puckering tool via the path below. Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Puckering ▶ Edit Puckering 2D Window Toolbar ▶ Edit Puckering Object Browser ▶ Select the Puckering Icon in the Object Browser (Ver. 2025.0) ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 132418.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438147484697) 2\. Click & drag to select the line segment or Left-Click on the puckering line to edit the puckering. 3\. To delete the puckering, select the puckering line and press the Delete key on the keyboard. ### End Result → Move Position: Select & drag the puckering line to move the entire line. → Modify Length: Click and drag the end point of the puckering to modify the length. If you right-click while editing the length, a Moving Distance dialogue will appear, allowing you to move it to the desired numerical value. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Puckering Style Properties Set the properties of a Puckering Style. ### Operation 1\. Select a puckering object / line with the Edit Puckering tool. The Properties are displayed in the Property Editor beneath the Object Browser. Edit the selected puckering. **Puckering object properties** **Property** | **Description** ---|--- Name | Changes the name of the puckering object. Puckering Property (ver. 2025.0) | Changes the puckering style. Extend | Extends the start/end of the puckering to the outline of the 2D pattern. Offset | Offset | Adjusts the distance the puckering is spaced from the pattern outline. Include or exclude the width of the puckering from the spacing as needed. Z Offset | Adjust the Z-axis distance of the puckering. Placement | Both Sides | *For Puckering on Internal Lines only. Check the box to have Puckering appear on both sides of the Internal Line. Flip | *For Puckering on Internal Lines only. Check the box to flip the puckering to the other side of the internal line. 2\. Another option is to right-click on the applied puckering with Edit Puckering active to apply the options as needed. **Menu** | **Description** ---|--- Select All With the Same Property | Selects puckering with the same styles as the selected puckering. Assign to New Puckering | Adds and applies a new puckering style. Delete | Deletes the puckering. ※Note: You can also delete by pressing the Delete key on your keyboard. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Assign Puckering Style Applies the Puckering style to the selected Puckering lines. ### **Apply with a generated Puckering style** 1\. When generating Puckering: After selecting a Puckering style in the Puckering window, it will be applied as the selected style when generated. 2\. Apply after Puckering is created: Select a Puckering line and click the 'Apply' button to the right of the Puckering style. **Apply as a new Puckering Style** 1\. Select a Puckering line and add it with the 'Assign' button at the top of the Puckering window. 2\. Select a Puckering line and add it to the 'Assign to New Puckering' menu from the right-click menu. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Puckering Style Properties You can adjust the properties of the Puckering style to achieve different forms of puckering. When you select a Puckering Style in the Puckering window, the Puckering Style properties appear in the Properties window. Open/Save Puckering Styles: You can save and recall styles via the Open and Save buttons at the top of the properties window. **Puckering Style Properties** **Information** | Name | Change the name of the puckering style. ---|---|--- **Material** | There are five presets available: Cotton, Denim, Leather, Nylon, and Polyester. Basic Parameters | Texture | Apply a texture. Desaturation | Use to leave the pattern or texture of the texture image and vary the overall color of the rest of the image. Shadow Intensity | Adjusts the shadow intensity of the texture. Shadow Brightness | Adjusts the brightness of the shadows, leaving the pattern or texture of the texture image. Normal Map | Brings up a normal map to change the appearance of the puckering. Intensity (%) | Adjusts the intensity. Color | Adjusts the color of the texture. Opacity | Adjusts the transparency of the texture. **Specification** | Density % | Adjusts the density of the texture. Width | Adjusts the width. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438164865433) ## Show/Hide Puckering You can show or hide the overall puckering. ### Steps 1\. In the 2D window Location Main Menu → Display → Materials → Show Puckering View icon in 2D window → 2D Sewing → Show Puckering 2\. In the 3D window Location Main Menu → Display → Materials → Show Puckering View icon in 3D window → 3D Trims Display → Show Puckering ### End Result → You can show or hide all the created puckering in the window.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive instructions on creating, editing, and applying puckering styles to enhance the realism of fabric textures in garment design.

title: Quick Pinching /Advanced Pinching with Soft Selection (Ver. 2025.0)
content: ## Quick Pinching ### Objective Like the existing pinching feature, Quick Pinching allows for fast and simple pinching by pulling the mouse-picked point as a single point. ### Location Quick Pinching is automatically activated while simulation is running: * Quick Pinching (Q): It is executed by default when the simulation starts. * 3D Tool Bar ▶ Drop-Down Menu ▶ Quick Pinching (Ver. 2025.0) ![Selectmove.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438152064025) ![SelectQuickPinch.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438152167833) ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438199330713) ## Advanced Pinching ### Objective Advanced Pinching is an evolved version of Quick Pinching that allows for precise pinching based on the user's desired area and fall-off settings. ### Location Advanced Pinching can be activated while simulation is running: * **Ver. 2025.0:** 3D Tool Bar ▶ Pinching Drop-Down Menu ▶ Advanced Pinching ![SelectAdvancedpinching2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438152548121) * **Up to Ver. 2024.2:** 3D Background Context Menu (Right-click 3D background) ▶ Advanced Pinching (Shift + E) ### Operation (2025.0) 1. Load a garment into the scene. 2. Activate Simulation and select the Select/Move Tool ( Q ). 3. (With simulation active) Select Advanced Pinching from the Location above. 4. The Advanced Pinch Settings dialog window will pop up _(see images below)_ 5. In the Option section, adjust the following tool options to your preference: ### Operation (up to ver. 2024.2) 1. Load a garment into the scene. 2. Activate Simulation and select the Select/Move Tool ( Q ). 3. (With simulation active) Right-click the background in the 3D Window to bring up the 3D Background Context Menu. 4. Run the Advanced Pinch (Shift + E) option. 5. The Advanced Pinch Settings dialog window will pop up _(see images below)_ 6. In the Option section, adjust the following tool options to your preference: Range | The shape graph reflects the selected Falloff(Shape * Distance * Power) and cannot be manipulated directly. ---|--- Falloff Shape | Select the Falloff Shape: Bump or Linear ![falloff shape.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438138557465) Falloff Distance | Set the distance of the selection range to the radius: Min/max: 1-500(mm) ![Visual indicator of falloff distance.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438138699289) Falloff Power | A value that sets the strength of falloff. Min:-2.0 Max:+2.0 ![4869aa7f-745f-4861-a5c8-64257497e6bf.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438153202201) Options | Distance Measure | How the distance from the picking point is measured. Surface | When multiple layers of patterns are together, only one independent layer will be selected. Straight | Select all patterns within a certain distance from the picking point regardless of the layer selected. Distance Indicator | Indicates the Falloff Distance/Power values using 2 concentric circles around the pinch icon. When turned off the circles will disappear. ![78de1a69-72a1-4cc6-acc5-2031751e5df2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438216650393) Limit to Selected Patterns | When selected only one pattern will be affected regardless of whether the Distance Measure is Surface or Straight. ![999a90e8-8b62-4bab-ae88-7a84bb454b03.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438167297049) Display Weights | Displays a contrasting color to the mesh where the weight value is applied. ![2d28e3ff-3eea-412a-a077-ee328038e99b.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438201394073) Modify the Range and Option values and freely pinch the patterns.
content_description: Discover the streamlined pinching capabilities of Quick and Advanced Pinching features, designed to enhance your garment simulation experience with precise control and effortless execution.

title: Fabric Style Property Editor (Ver. 2025.0)
content: Fabric Information Material PBR Material Substance ### ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241091737) Objective Express the texture or pattern of the fabric. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric ![FabrisStyle-PropertyEditor.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988256609945) ### Operation 1. Select the menu indicated in Location. 2. Select a fabric. → Fabric properties appear in Property Editor. 3. Refer to the table below to set the base texture. 4. Select PBR or Substance from the drop-down menu. PBR: Adjust Base Color, Normal Map, Displacement Map, Opacity, and Reflection. *Includes Metalness Map. Substance: Assign Adobe Substance material file. ### Fabric Information Option | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Edit the name of Fabric Physical Property | Name of physical property Created by | Name of Fabric Data State | Data of the Fabric. ### ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241091737) Material PBR (Default) Edit each property for the Front / Back / Side of the mesh. Option | Description ---|--- Texture Mapping | Repeat | Tile the texture across the UV map. Unified | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. Type | Select the desired Material Type. Base Color | Click the Explore button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241095961) ) and apply a texture image from Library/Folder ※Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Color Switch | Desaturate: Desaturate the entire Base Color Map to remove color and convert it into grayscale or black and white. Switch: Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241096985) ※Note: The Base Color Map should contain 1 color for consistent results. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Normal Map | A texture image that stores surface normal information in an RGB image. Intensity | When a texture is applied, a Normal Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241099033) ) Adjust the Intensity with the slider. Higher intensity results in more pronounced details, and a lower intensity makes the details less pronounced. Open | Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241095961) ) to open a custom Normal map image. After you open an image, the Transformation settings for Angle, Width, Height, and Aspect Ratio are enabled. Add Another App | An Additional Application can be registered to open an assigned texture. Once registered, the application will be listed and remain available for future use. Open With Another App | Open the image in another App (for example, Photoshop) Displacement Map | Express the thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. Note: Displacement maps are only visible when rendered in the rendering engine. Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Opacity | Express the level of transparency using a grayscale image map. Opacity | Adjust the Opacity level from 0-100. Mode: RGB | The encoded map with the alpha value in the RGB channel. Mode: Alpha | The encoded map with the alpha value in an alpha channel. Reflection | Intensity | Edit the fabric gloss by adjusting the Intensity of the Roughness. Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying the Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shiny part becomes dull and vice versa. To use the Specular Maps provided in Ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | The greater the Reflection Intensity value is, the more reflective the material or fabric is, and vice versa. Metalness | Adjust the metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. Open the Metalness map by clicking the square icon, or click the Generate icon to automatically generate a Metalness map from your texture image. ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/51988241091737) ### Material Substance Edit each property for the Front / Back / Side of the mesh. Use the SBSAR file of Substance, which is the main application of physically-based rendering. To get a better rendering result for substance materials, enable High-Quality Render in the 3D window. Option | Description ---|--- Substance File | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. (Adobe Substance 3D Assets, Adobe Substance Community Assets, Adobe Substance 3D). * SBSAR file can be imported by Object Browser> Right-click on the Fabric item. Delete | Delete the SBSAR file. Add Another App | Additional Application can be registered to open an assigned texture. Once registered, the application will be listed and remain available for future use. Open with Another App | Open the image in another App (for example, Photoshop) Preset | Choose the preset of SBSAR. Resolution | Adjust image resolution of SBSAR. Custom Properties | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ※Note: Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. Refer to the Substance Manual for more detailed information. ※ Note: * Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. * Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab.
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for selecting and editing fabric properties, including texture mapping and material customization, within the Marvelous Designer software.
